title: C2b: did:key Pkarr CORUNDUM entry (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16), option A: the did:key Pkarr record may carry an optional CORUNDUM service entry naming the operator content endpoint and posting key; the user's device updates the record only when switching operators; the operator re-publishes the signed record to keep it alive. Agora §2.1 / §10.3.4.6 change from 'fixed entries only' to 'listed entries plus listed optional service entries', never naming a relay.
